retained.representation: derived allowlisted aggregate and executable identity; not raw receipt

privacy: Only screened aggregate fields, timestamps, executable size/hash and source file hashes retained. No raw private JSONL read or copied; no process/session/request IDs, credentials, messages, command lines, environments or raw receipt payloads retained. input_sha256 identifies excluded input, not payload. Manifest excludes itself from retained-file count.
proof_scope: Supplied independent screening/receipts only; no new live inspection, source provenance, tests, builds, checks, network or operations.
